title: Odoo User Guide
tagline: Learn to navigate Odoo and complete everyday CRM, Sales, Inventory, Accounting, activity, and reporting tasks.
description: A practical beginner guide for employees and business users who need to use Odoo in their daily work — not a deep technical course, but a reference-style walkthrough of the screens and workflows you'll touch every day.
Built from the questions real end users ask most: how do I find this record, why did that field lock, what does this button actually do.
learningOutcomes: Navigate Odoo applications and records confidently
Manage CRM leads, opportunities, and follow-ups
Create quotations and turn them into sales orders
Track products, inventory, deliveries, and receipts
Use activities, filters, and reports to stay on top of your work
whoItsFor: Employees using Odoo for daily sales, purchasing, accounting, HR, or operational work
Business teams that need to create consistent records and collaborate through shared workflows
Business owners who want to understand how departments and transactions connect inside one ERP
Complete beginners building a clear foundation before a role-based Odoo course
requirements: No previous Odoo or ERP experience required
Access to an Odoo instance (trial or company account)

curriculum.title: Odoo Navigation and Records
curriculum.description: Understand apps, dashboards, menus, views, records, search, filters, grouping, and favorites.

curriculum.title: CRM and Customer Follow-Up
curriculum.description: Manage leads, opportunities, customer communication, activities, and pipeline progress.

curriculum.title: Sales Workflow
curriculum.description: Create quotations, confirm sales orders, manage customers, and follow the sales process.

curriculum.title: Inventory Essentials
curriculum.description: Work with products, stock levels, deliveries, receipts, warehouses, and stock movements.

curriculum.title: Invoices and Payment Flow
curriculum.description: Create invoices, register payments, and understand how commercial documents connect.

curriculum.title: Activities, Dashboards, and Reports
curriculum.description: Schedule follow-ups and use filters, dashboards, and reports to understand performance.

projects.title: Customer-to-Invoice Workflow
projects.description: Complete a connected scenario from a new customer enquiry to quotation, delivery, invoice, and payment.

projects.title: Clean Data Challenge
projects.description: Find and correct duplicate, incomplete, or inconsistent records using good ERP habits.

projects.title: Personal Work Dashboard
projects.description: Build useful filters, favorites, activities, and reports for a daily role.

faq.question: Is this suitable for someone with no ERP experience?
faq.answer: Yes. The guide starts with the interface and shared Odoo concepts before moving into connected business workflows.

faq.question: Does this course require programming?
faq.answer: No. It focuses entirely on practical end-user work and business operations.

faq.question: Which Odoo apps are included?
faq.answer: The scope covers CRM, Sales, Inventory, basic Accounting, Activities, and Reports.

faq.question: What should I study next?
faq.answer: After this guide, choose the Crash Course, System Admin, Implementation, Automation, or Development track according to your role.
